name: weather
title: Weather: observations for the valley and the regional ring

sources.name: awc_metar
sources.license: US Government work; no license stated (public domain assumed)
sources.credit: NOAA National Weather Service, Aviation Weather Center

storage: No tables of its own yet: readings go to core's raw.record until a core station and readings table lands (ch. 17 Q8). AWC METARs: about 170-250 reports a day from five airports, each a raw.record row of about 0.4 KB of JSON (about 1 KB with indexes): roughly 0.2 MB a day, 70 MB a year. One request every 10 minutes, about 25 KB uncompressed (a few KB gzipped).
ethics: Weather at airports, nothing about people. AWC's keyless API is used as its page asks: one small bounding-box request every 10 minutes (the limit is 100 a minute), with our honest User-Agent; robots.txt has no rules (404, Oct 7). api.weather.gov stays off-limits (robots.txt Disallow: /; ch. 17 Q13). AWC states no license; NWS data are US Government works, so public domain is assumed and AWC is credited.
